settings.quality_basis: First completed run per PDF; first attempt represents a PDF if all attempts failed.
settings.confidence: Minimum value-token Tesseract confidence divided by 100; null for pypdf.
settings.normalization: Collapse whitespace; case and lookalike characters are preserved in values.
settings.latency: Extraction through normalized fields, including rendering and subprocess/temporary I/O for OCR. Percentiles use linear interpolation over completed runs.
